title: Чужие споры и законы кухни  (Other People's Arguments and Kitchen Laws)

scenes.title: Война порядков в квартире  (A War of House Rules in the Apartment)
scenes.summary: Nastya and Sasha clash in the apartment kitchen over reorganizing the shelves, poisoning cockroaches, and worrying that Pashka the turtle looks sluggish.

scenes.title: Шеф в больничной палате  (The Chef in the Hospital Ward)
scenes.summary: Max and Kostya hope the girls will make peace at work, while in the hospital Chef Barinov argues with his doctor about his MRI results and strict bed rest.

scenes.title: Просьба о сигаретах в больнице  (Begging for Cigarettes in the Hospital)
scenes.summary: Once the doctor leaves the ward, Chef Barinov immediately tries to talk hospital orderly Nikolai into sneaking him a pack of cigarettes.

scenes.title: Бессмысленный спор Сени и Феди  (Senya and Fedya's Pointless Argument)
scenes.summary: In the Claude Monet kitchen, Senya and Fedya launch into a heated argument that starts with dogs versus cats and escalates to Russian pop stars.

scenes.title: Чужая чашка у бара  (Someone Else's Mug at the Bar)
scenes.summary: While Senya and Fedya keep bickering over Galkin in the kitchen, Sasha irritates Nastya at the bar by drinking morning coffee out of Nastya's favorite mug.

scenes.title: Забастовка у плиты  (A Strike at the Stove)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya's argument over Galkin halts all orders in the kitchen, and when Lyova tries to make them work, they snap at him to stop yelling like the Chef.

scenes.title: Совет из больницы  (Advice from the Hospital)
scenes.summary: Desperate to get Senya and Fedya back to work, Lyova calls Chef Barinov in the hospital, who advises him to lock them in the walk-in fridge or trick them into reconciling.

scenes.title: План примирения в холодильнике  (The Reconciliation Plan in the Fridge)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov explains how to trick each cook into apologizing first, while Max suggests locking Nastya and Sasha inside the walk-in fridge so they will make peace too.

scenes.title: Тайный перекур и заказ куропаток  (A Secret Smoke Break and Ordering Partridges)
scenes.summary: In the hospital, Chef Barinov sneaks a cigarette with his ward neighbor until he gets dizzy, while Max tricks Nastya into entering the walk-in fridge by asking for four partridges.

scenes.title: Запертые в холодильнике  (Locked in the Walk-in Fridge)
scenes.summary: Max and Kostya trick both Nastya and Sasha into stepping inside the walk-in refrigerator and lock the door, only for the two girls to immediately start insulting each other.

scenes.title: Новое столкновение Сени и Феди  (Senya and Fedya Clash Again)
scenes.summary: Following Lyova's trick, Senya and Fedya both apologize at the same time, immediately realize Lyova manipulated them, and resume their argument with even greater fury.

scenes.title: Битва за кастрюлю  (Battle over the Soup Pot)
scenes.summary: After being let out of the fridge, Nastya and Sasha continue their feud at home over a broken mug and who owns the soup pot on the stove.

scenes.title: Секрет настоящего Шефа  (The Secret of a True Chef)
scenes.summary: Lyova visits Chef Barinov in the hospital to admit that the reconciliation trick failed, and Barinov explains that to command the kitchen, a chef must act like a ruthless tyrant.

scenes.title: Цирк на кухне  (A Circus in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: While Chef Barinov deals with a bossy hospital nurse, Lyova returns to Claude Monet to find Senya and Fedya sabotaging each other's dishes.

scenes.title: Лёва включает тирана  (Lyova Unleashes His Inner Tyrant)
scenes.summary: Following Barinov's advice, Lyova shocks the entire kitchen by screaming at Vika, smashing plates, and stripping the staff of their bonuses until everyone scrambles back to work.

scenes.title: Постановочная драка друзей  (The Friends' Staged Brawl)
scenes.summary: To make Nastya and Sasha stop fighting, Max convinces Kostya to stage a loud argument and fistfight between the two of them right in front of the girls.

scenes.title: Примирение за чаем  (Making Peace over Tea)
scenes.summary: When Max and Kostya return home bruised and claiming they fought over the girls, Nastya and Sasha feel guilty and immediately make peace over tea.

scenes.title: Жертва ради мира  (A Sacrifice for Peace)
scenes.summary: After Kostya accidentally injures his arm for real, Max reflects that the only way to win someone else's argument is to sacrifice yourself for peace.
